content: Replace the ad hoc roadmap numbering with one explicit SemVer policy, migrate every current and historical M/W/S identity to a four-part delivery coordinate, move deferred host and qualification work from the mistaken v1.0 label to v0.2.0, and publish the correction to the active M0100 completion session.

D0024 establishes three-part product SemVer from VERSION and four-part MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.WORK delivery coordinates. M0100/M0110/M0120/M0130 own v0.1.0/v0.1.1/v0.1.2/v0.1.3; Intel host, physical NVIDIA binding performance, and native NixOS qualification belong to v0.2.0. This is the one breaking migration that rewrites all pre-policy M/W/S identities and their historical references without changing the evidence claims or cited revisions.

Content revision 78fc9d8caa6b6fe1396e77f8728edb14f0f0a05f establishes the version source, derived M/W identities and S tooling, collision gates, release-boundary correction, and renamed build/test identifiers. Follow-up revision 8b79bb00876efa17b3899c50c756fff9fbafee94 makes latest-session selection chronological across delivery scopes. Final content revision 209caee4fd1eb7af98a9d9b5abefd18cf28fce97 rejects legacy and truncated session references in durable Agent records; the separate closing record commit owns the 25-session history migration. Dev configure/build and CTest 63/63 passed; Agent records 111/111, guidance 17/17, routing corpus 68 cases and self-test 23/23, 18 skill packages, Python compilation, diff check, and legacy-identifier scans passed.

Published G002 to S0100-20260830-001-m0100-completion-sprint, superseding G001 only for the release-version boundary. The ready packet tells the owner to keep absent physical NVIDIA and native NixOS evidence incomplete, preserve the strict harness, and schedule those qualifications with Intel under v0.2.0; the transient packet remains excluded from Git until owner disposition.
